![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

The current logic rebuilds the list of special tokens by concatenating existing `extra_special_tokens` with new `timestamps` and `sc` tokens, and then passes this entire list to `add_special_tokens`. While this works because `add_special_tokens` is idempotent, it's inefficient and not idiomatic. The method is designed to *add* new tokens, not reset the list.

A clearer, more efficient, and more robust approach is to only add the new tokens. This avoids unnecessary processing and makes the intent of the code explicit.

```suggestion
        self.tokenizer.tokenizer.add_special_tokens(
            dict(extra_special_tokens=timestamps + sc)
        )
```
